entities.summary: DQ is a Danish singer and drag queen who won the Danish Melodi Grand Prix 2007 and therefore represented Denmark in the Eurovision Song Contest 2007 with the song "Drama Queen". The song failed to qualify in the semi-final stage, placing 19th with 45 points.
